module: Flowgraph `pin` class: represents an input or output pin of a node (name, type, direction, value, links). The module returns a constructor: `require('flowgraph_pin')(graph, node, direction, type, name, default, description)`. Node modders manipulate it through `self.pinIn.<name>` / `self.pinOut.<name>` (`.value` field, `:isUsed()`, `:valueSetVec3/Quat`). The rest (drawing, tooltip, menu) serves the ImGui editor.
notes: Usage tracking (`enableUsageTracking = true`) replaces the `__index`/`__newindex` of the class table: reading or writing `pin.value` actually accesses `_value` and updates `_frameLastUsed` with the manager's frame counter.
Since the modified metatables are those of the shared class (`getmetatable(self)`), this behavior applies to all pins.
`valueSetVec3` and `valueSetQuat` reuse the same `valueHelperTable` table (no allocation): do not keep the returned table between frames; vec3 sets `[4] = nil`.
For a non-flow `in` pin, only one link is kept (`links[1]`); for flows or outputs, several links stack up.
`pinMode` is 'normal' by default; 'hardcoded' means the value is fixed in the editor (the pin then counts as used).
In `_draw_in`, `constValue` is checked with `~= nil` to display a padlock.

C.desc: Flowgraph pin. Notable fields: graph, id, name, type (string or list of types), direction ('in'/'out'), node, default, defaultValue, description, hidden, links, hardTemplates, impulse, chainFlow, tableType, pinMode, quickAccess.

init.desc: Constructor: records the graph, gets a unique id from the manager (`getNextFreePinLinkId`), stores name/type/direction/default value and enables usage tracking of `value`. An output pin of type `delegate` gets `hasOutputDelegates = true`.

type.desc: Pin type (flow, number, string, bool, vec3, quat, color, table, any...) or list of types.

description.desc: Help text shown in the tooltip.

getFirstConnectedLink.desc: Returns the pin's first link (`links[1]`), or nil.

_draw_in.desc: Draws an input pin in the editor (type icon, name, optional constant value with a padlock).

constValue.desc: Constant value to display, or nil.

_draw_out.desc: Draws an output pin in the editor (right-aligned name then icon).

getTypeWithImpulseAndChain.desc: Returns 'impulse' if the pin is an impulse, 'chainFlow' if it is a chained flow, otherwise its type (used to choose the icon).

getTableType.desc: If the pin is of type table (or includes table), returns `tableType` (or 'generic'); otherwise an empty string.

_getCalculatedWidth.desc: Computes the pin's display width (icon + text + margin).

simpleDraw.desc: Not used (the mode is read from the preferences).

isActive.desc: While a link is being created, tells whether this pin can be a target (active) or should be grayed out.

drawTooltip.desc: Displays the pin's ImGui tooltip: name, valid or connected type, table type and description.

highlightLinks.desc: Marks all of the pin's links as highlighted (`_highlight = true`).

draw.desc: Draws the pin (according to `direction`) with the right opacity, handles the click (node selection) and remembers the hover.

hoverDraw.desc: If the pin is hovered, highlights its links and displays its tooltip.

showContextMenu.desc: Pin context menu in the editor: quick access, hide the pin (if it has no links), show/hide its links, debug.

_onLink.desc: Called when a link is created: replaces `links[1]` (non-flow input) or adds the link; makes the pin visible.

_onUnlink.desc: Called when a link is deleted: removes it from the list.

isUsed.desc: Returns true if the pin has at least one link or if its value is hardcoded (`pinMode == 'hardcoded'`). Used by some nodes to skip unnecessary computations.

valueSetVec3.desc: Writes a vector into `value` as a reused {x, y, z} table (no allocation).

valueSetQuat.desc: Writes a quaternion into `value` as a reused {x, y, z, w} table.
